entities.name: Myojin
entities.description: The greatest kami of Kamigawa, five beings each embodying a color of magic.

entities.name: O-Kagachi
entities.description: The kami of all things, whose power exceeded the myojin.

entities.name: Myojin of Night's Reach
entities.description: Black-aligned myojin who exploited weakened planar boundaries to reach many planes.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War in which the kami turned against the material world.

entities.name: Konda
entities.description: Person whose crime drove the kami into chaos and anger.

entities.name: Honden
entities.description: Shrines built in honor of each myojin, abandoned during the Kami War.

events.summary: Kamigawa's denizens pray to the Myojin at the start of the Kami War, but the Myojin, in chaos over Konda's crime, turn against the material world like the other kami.
events.quote: like all other kami, the Myojin turned against the material world

events.summary: The Myojin of Night's Reach exploits weakened planar boundaries to gain access to many other planes.
events.quote: the Myojin of Night's Reach was able to exploit the planar boundaries weakening during the Kami War

events.summary: The Honden shrines are abandoned and nearly ruined during the Kami War.
events.quote: During the Kami War, the shrines faced abandonment and were almost in ruin.

relations.quote: are the greatest kami of all in the plane of Kamigawa
The power of the five myojin was dwarfed only by O-Kagachi , the kami of all things.
